item.title: Urgent: Outstanding Maintenance Issues in Alleyway Between King Hall Road and Clock House Station, 21st August
item.description:
I am writing to express my concern regarding the ongoing condition of the alleyway running from King Hall Road through to Clock House Station. Although the section near King Hall Road has recently been attended to, the remainder of the alleyway appears to have been overlooked. The area remains heavily overgrown with weeds and is strewn with litter, indicating that it has not been properly maintained for some time. I am disappointed to note that this issue remains unresolved. If the Waste Management Team were to inspect the full length of the alleyway, they would clearly identify the areas of concern rather than concluding that the problem cannot be located. As this route is regularly used by pedestrians, its current condition presents a potential health and safety risk. Overgrown vegetation and accumulated debris could increase the likelihood of slips, trips, and falls, particularly during wet weather or in poor lighting conditions. I would also like to request that the weeds along the entire length of the alleyway be cut back, as they have become significantly overgrown since the last maintenance work was carried out. In addition, please ensure that the area is thoroughly cleaned, with all litter removed and the pathway swept to a reasonable standard. In addition to the safety concerns, the neglected appearance of the alleyway creates an unsightly environment for local residents, commuters, and visitors to the area. I would therefore be grateful if a thorough inspection of the entire alleyway could be carried out and arrangements made for the overgrowth to be cut back, all litter removed, and the pathway cleaned as a matter of urgency. I would appreciate confirmation that these works will be completed. Thank you
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Kings Hall Road, Penge, Greater London
